$description: Cards that exist in a Claude Design design-system project but that build-bundle.js cannot produce, because the slug has no `case "<slug>":` branch in components/render/renderer/html-renderers/ds-html-map.js and therefore is not in RENDER_SLUGS. A rebuild omits them silently and a push never deletes, so without this file they survive unexplained. Found by diffing the generated bundle against the live dogfood project on 2026-09-23. status: keep = stays hand-made outside the substrate; author = a leaf is owed in knowledge; retire = should leave the project; undecided = not yet ruled on. tests/render/bundle-external.test.js keeps this honest.
